description: Advisory CI family inventory; no family selection or required coverage gate is activated.

provenance.historical_basis: source_revision and input digests describe the original hand inventory, not the current generated tree.

engine.boundary_rule: Exact module; package boundary includes descendants, except the digitalmodel root facade is exact only. Boundary requires product-manager confirmation.

test_home_rule: Only Git-tracked Python files are inventoried. Existing file homes are preserved. Newly tracked files use the longest directory prefix in assignment_rules, defaulting to platform. Environments, nested checkouts and linked directories are excluded. Inventory drift is report-only until family gates are activated.
dependency_measurement: Static absolute and relative AST imports and every ENGINE ancestor of each target, including function-local and TYPE_CHECKING imports; dynamic imports are not measured.
